STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 15 Posts - Complete Details

Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for Apprentice Trainee posts. A total of 15 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment drive. The online application process will be conducted from 14 September 2026 to 30 September 2026. Interested candidates can apply online through the official website, stpi.in.

Important Dates

  • Advertisement Date : 14.09.2026
  • Advertisement Release Date : 14.09.2026
  • STPI Apprentice Trainee Last Date to apply online : On or before 30.09.2026
  • Crucial date for age reckoning : 14.09.2026

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Apprentice Trainee
  • STPI Apprentice Trainee Last Date to apply online : On or before 30.09.2026
  • STPI Centre : Number of Vacancies
  • Maximum Age – OBC : 30 years
  • Maximum Age – SC/ST : 32 years

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
